activity_summary: You saved a view of John Heminges's chalk reckoning slate at Holywell breaking down the twenty-pound Greenwich warrant into expenses and eight equal parts of thirty-seven shillings and sixpence.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept a capture of Heminges's chalk cast at Holywell.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Cast the twenty-pound Chamber warrant into eight equal parts on the slate.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Hosted the midday reckoning at his house in Holywell.

entities.name: Edith Kettlewood
entities.context: Eight shillings set aside for her from the stock part, payable Thursday.

entities.name: Greenwich Chamber warrant
entities.context: Mentioned in Heminges's warrant reckoning slate
